$comment: Canonical manifest of the ten architecture rules (D-09 as amended by D-35, plus D-34 and D-19). Read by both scripts/ci/verify-arch-rules-fire.sh and tests/Arch/FiringHarnessTest.php, so the two never drift. Every rule id here MUST have a matching test in tests/Arch/LayerBoundariesTest.php, tests/Arch/StrictTypesTest.php or tests/Arch/SecretLoggingTest.php, and at least one fixture file under tests/Arch/Fixtures/<id>/.

rules.description: Gateway is the only layer that may reference HubSpot\* SDK classes
Registry may depend only on Gateway, the package exceptions and the framework
R3: Sync may depend only on Registry, Gateway, the package exceptions and the framework
Webhooks may depend only on Registry, Gateway, the package exceptions and the framework
Signals may depend only on Registry, Gateway, the package exceptions and the framework
Frontend may depend only on the public facade
Signals may not depend on Sync or Webhooks (peer, not consumer)
Frontend may not reference HubSpot\* or any internal layer
Config keys holding tokens or secrets never appear in log calls
